name: Jackie Ng
title: Structural Biologist & Founder · Brain Delivery with ML · AtomBios
tagline: Engineering nanoparticles that cross the blood-brain barrier.
description: Structural biologist turned founder, using ML to discover the 20nm BBB-crossing LNP. Published in J. Biological Chemistry. 20nm nanoparticles for BBB crossing: 8× transcytosis, 3.2-fold brain accumulation. HK$7.05M funded. Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting 2025. Building corona-programmable delivery.
